claim: Confirmado via observacao READ-ONLY no lab HWA 10.2.8 (container tws-hwa, MDM): (1) TWSConfig.properties do engineServer contem com.hcl.tws.failover.master.polling=10, com.hcl.tws.failover.master.treshold=300, com.hcl.tws.failover.event.polling=10 e com.hcl.tws.failover.event.treshold=300 (presentes tanto em /opt/hwa/usr/servers/engineServer/resources/properties quanto em /opt/hwa/TWSDATA/usr/servers/engineServer/resources/properties); (2) as opcoes globais workstationMasterListInAutomaticFailover (wm) e workstationEventMgrListInAutomaticFailover (we) estao VAZIAS via optman ls, logo todos os backup master domain managers do dominio sao elegiveis. Corrobora as claims canonicas hwa-10.2.8-failover-twsconfig-detection-params-0001, hwa-10.2.8-globalopts-workstationmasterlistinautomaticfailover-0001 e hwa-10.2.8-globalopts-workstationeventmgrlistinautomaticfailover-0001.
platform: Distributed; Linux x86_64; container RHEL9 UBI; MDM host tws-hwa; dominio Run 69
command: grep failover TWSConfig.properties (2 paths) + optman ls (somente leitura); sem mutacao
preconditions: MDM master; enAutomaticFailover=yes; nenhum teste destrutivo de failover (trigger mutante permanece gateado ao dono)
sanitized_output: TWSConfig.properties: com.hcl.tws.failover.master.polling=10; com.hcl.tws.failover.master.treshold=300; com.hcl.tws.failover.event.polling=10; com.hcl.tws.failover.event.treshold=300. optman ls: workstationMasterListInAutomaticFailover / wm = (vazio); workstationEventMgrListInAutomaticFailover / we = (vazio). Nenhuma credencial, IP ou hostname real incluido.
observations: 1) Os parametros de deteccao do failover estao no default (polling 10s, threshold 300s) em ambos os arquivos TWSConfig.properties (instalacao e TWSDATA). 2) wm/we vazios => todos os backup MDMs elegiveis (autofailover af=yes, aa=yes, mm resolve master=no). 3) Observacao 100% read-only; nenhum teste de failover executado.
